mapper.select: SELECT t.tdm51_chck_org_id AS chck_org_id , t.tdm51_chck_job_id AS chck_job_id , t.tdm51_org_id AS org_id , t.tdm51_check_ym AS check_ym , t.tdm51_role_nm AS role_name , t.tdm51_exct_nm AS exct_name , t.tdm51_task_cnt AS task_cnt , t.tdm51_detail_cnt AS detail_cnt , t.tdm51_duty_cnt AS duty_cnt , t.tdm51_manl_cnt AS manl_cnt , t.tdm51_month_manl_cnt AS month_manl_cnt , t.tdm51_month_check_cnt AS month_check_cnt , t.tdm51_month_check1_cnt AS month_check1_cnt , t.tdm51_month_check2_cnt AS month_check2_cnt , t.tdm51_month_check9_cnt AS month_check9_cnt , t.tdm51_insuff_cnt AS insuff_cnt , t.tdm51_check_end_yn AS check_end_yn , t.tdm51_org_status_cd AS org_status_code , f_cdnm('TdmCheckStatus', t.tdm51_org_status_cd, t.tdm51_company_id, f_today()) AS org_status_name , t.tdm51_fix_yn AS fix_yn , t.tdm51_check_status_all10_yn AS check_status_all10_yn , t.tdm51_insuff_un_action_yn AS insuff_un_action_yn , t.tdm51_insuff_reject_yn AS insuff_reject_yn FROM ( SELECT tdm51_chck_org.* , tdm20_role_nm AS tdm51_role_nm /*직책*/ , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm51_exct_id) AS tdm51_exct_nm /*임원*/ , task_cnt AS tdm51_task_cnt /*항목수_책무*/ , detail_cnt AS tdm51_detail_cnt /*항목수_책무세부*/ , duty_cnt AS tdm51_duty_cnt /*항목수_관리의무*/ , manl_cnt AS tdm51_manl_cnt /*항목수_점검항목*/ , month_manl_cnt AS tdm51_month_manl_cnt /*항목수_당월대상*/ , month_check_cnt AS tdm51_month_check_cnt /*당월점검_점검건수*/ , month_check1_cnt AS tdm51_month_check1_cnt /*당월점검_적정*/ , month_check2_cnt AS tdm51_month_check2_cnt /*당월점검_미흡*/ , month_check9_cnt AS tdm51_month_check9_cnt /*당월점검_해당없음*/ , insuff_cnt AS tdm51_insuff_cnt /*미흡건수*/ , CASE WHEN month_manl_cnt = 0 THEN false WHEN (month_manl_null_cnt + month_manl_10_cnt + month_manl_11_cnt) != 0 THEN false ELSE true END AS tdm51_check_end_yn /*점검완료여부*/ , CASE WHEN month_manl_cnt = 0 THEN null WHEN month_manl_26_cnt != 0 THEN '26' WHEN insuff_reject_cnt != 0 THEN '26' ELSE (CASE WHEN month_manl_cnt = month_manl_25_cnt THEN '25' WHEN month_manl_cnt = month_manl_20_cnt THEN '20' WHEN month_manl_cnt = month_manl_21_cnt OR month_manl_cnt = month_manl_25_cnt + month_manl_21_cnt + month_manl_20_cnt THEN '21' ELSE null END) END AS tdm51_org_status_cd /*승인상태*/ , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm60_chck_manl_appr WHERE tdm60_chck_manl_id IN ( SELECT tdm52_chck_manl_id FROM tdm52_chck_manl WHERE tdm52_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id )) = 0 THEN false ELSE true END AS tdm51_fix_yn /*확정여부(tdm60 존재시 true)*/ , CASE WHEN month_manl_cnt = 0 THEN false WHEN month_manl_cnt = month_manl_10_cnt THEN true ELSE false END AS tdm51_check_status_all10_yn /*점검상태 전체 대기(10) 여부*/ , CASE WHEN insuff_due_cnt = 0 THEN false ELSE true END AS tdm51_insuff_un_action_yn /*당월 조치완료예정 미흡내역 미조치여부*/ , CASE WHEN insuff_reject_cnt = 0 THEN false ELSE true END AS tdm51_insuff_reject_yn /*반려된 미흡/개선 조치내역 존재여부*/ FROM tdm51_chck_org CROSS JOIN ( SELECT tdm50_chck_job.* , COALESCE(( SELECT MAX(tdm50_check_ym) FROM tdm50_chck_job WHERE tdm50_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm50_check_ym < #{checkYm} ), '2000.01') pre_check_ym , f_get_tdmOrg_id2(tdm50_company_id, CAST(#{orgId} AS numeric), tdm50_start_date) tdmorg_id FROM tdm50_chck_job WHERE tdm50_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm50_check_ym = #{checkYm} ) tdm50 INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm51_role_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT tdm43_manl_org_id , COUNT(DISTINCT tdm43_task_id) task_cnt , COUNT(DISTINCT tdm43_task_relate_detail_id) detail_cnt , COUNT(DISTINCT tdm43_task_relate_duty_id) duty_cnt , COUNT(*) manl_cnt FROM tdm43_manl WHERE tdm43_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(tdm43_start_date,'1900-01-01'::date) <= (CAST(#{checkYm} AS varchar)||'.01')::date GROUP BY tdm43_manl_org_id ) tdm43 ON tdm43_manl_org_id = tdm51_manl_org_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT tdm52_chck_org_id , COUNT(*) month_manl_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm52_check_status_cd,'10') NOT IN ('','10','11') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_check_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm52_check_status_cd,'10') NOT IN ('','10','11') AND tdm52_check_result_cd = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_check1_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm52_check_status_cd,'10') NOT IN ('','10','11') AND tdm52_check_result_cd = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_check2_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm52_check_status_cd,'10') NOT IN ('','10','11') AND tdm52_check_result_cd = '9' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_check9_cnt , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '26' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_26_cnt /*승인반려(26)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_25_cnt /*승인완료(25)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '21' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_21_cnt /*승인진행(21)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '20' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_20_cnt /*승인요청(20)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '19' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_19_cnt /*점검완료(19)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_11_cnt /*점검진행(11)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd = '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_10_cnt /*점검대기(10)*/ , SUM(CASE WHEN tdm52_check_status_cd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) month_manl_null_cnt /*null*/ FROM tdm52_chck_manl WHERE tdm52_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY tdm52_chck_org_id ) tdm52 ON tdm52_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) insuff_cnt , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tdm54_status_cd IN ('10','11') AND tdm54_due_date <= tdm50_start_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) insuff_due_cnt , COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN tdm54_status_cd = '26' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) insuff_reject_cnt FROM tdm54_chck_insuff WHERE tdm54_company_id = tdm51_company_id AND tdm54_role_id = tdm51_role_id AND tdm54_org_id = tdm51_org_id AND tdm54_occ_ym < tdm51_check_ym AND 'Y' = (CASE WHEN tdm54_action_appr_ym < tdm51_check_ym THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) ) tdm54 ON TRUE WHERE tdm51_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm51_check_ym = #{checkYm} AND tdm51_org_id = tdmorg_id ) t ORDER BY t.tdm51_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT tdm51_chck_org_id AS chck_org_id , tdm51_company_id AS company_id , tdm51_check_ym AS check_ym , tdm51_chck_job_id AS chck_job_id , tdm51_org_id AS org_id FROM tdm51_chck_org WHERE tdm51_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm52_chck_manl WHERE tdm52_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} AND tdm52_checker_id IS NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN tdm51_exct_id = tdm58_appr_emp_id THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END FROM tdm51_chck_org INNER JOIN tdm58_chck_appr_step ON tdm58_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id WHERE tdm51_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} ORDER BY tdm58_appr_seq DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT emp00_org_code_id FROM tdm51_chck_org INNER JOIN tdm50_chck_job ON tdm50_chck_job_id = tdm51_chck_job_id INNER JOIN tdm58_chck_appr_step ON tdm58_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id INNER JOIN LATERAL getPerson(tdm51_company_id, tdm50_start_date) ON emp00_person_id = tdm58_appr_emp_id WHERE tdm51_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} GROUP BY emp00_org_code_id HAVING count(*) > 1

SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT emp00_kor_nm, ', ') FROM tdm51_chck_org INNER JOIN tdm50_chck_job ON tdm50_chck_job_id = tdm51_chck_job_id CROSS JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT tdm52_checker_id as person_id FROM tdm52_chck_manl WHERE tdm52_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} UNION ALL SELECT tdm58_appr_emp_id as person_id FROM tdm58_chck_appr_step WHERE tdm58_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} ) emp INNER JOIN LATERAL getPerson(tdm50_company_id, tdm50_end_date) ON emp00_person_id = person_id WHERE tdm51_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} AND emp00_retire_date IS NOT NULL AND emp00_retire_date <= tdm50_start_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm60_chck_manl_appr ( tdm60_chck_manl_appr_id, tdm60_chck_manl_id, tdm60_appr_seq, tdm60_appr_org_id, tdm60_appr_emp_id ) SELECT f_create_seq() , tdm52_chck_manl_id , tdm58_appr_seq , emp00_org_code_id , tdm58_appr_emp_id FROM tdm52_chck_manl INNER JOIN tdm58_chck_appr_step ON tdm58_chck_org_id = tdm52_chck_org_id INNER JOIN tdm51_chck_org ON tdm51_chck_org_id = tdm52_chck_org_id INNER JOIN tdm50_chck_job ON ( tdm50_company_id = tdm51_company_id AND tdm50_check_ym = tdm51_check_ym ) INNER JOIN getPerson(CAST(#{companyId} AS numeric), tdm50_start_date) ON emp00_person_id = tdm58_appr_emp_id WHERE tdm52_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} ORDER BY tdm52_chck_manl_id, tdm58_appr_seq
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tdm60_chck_manl_appr WHERE tdm60_chck_manl_id IN ( SELECT tdm52_chck_manl_id FROM tdm52_chck_manl WHERE tdm52_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} )
mapper.select: SELECT f_create_tdm59(CAST(#{actionType} AS varchar), CAST(#{chckOrgId} AS numeric))
mapper.update: UPDATE tdm60_chck_manl_appr SET tdm60_appr_status_cd = CAST(#{apprStatusCode} AS varchar) WHERE tdm60_chck_manl_id IN ( SELECT tdm52_chck_manl_id FROM tdm52_chck_manl WHERE tdm52_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} AND tdm52_check_status_cd = #{checkStatusCode} )
mapper.select: SELECT t.tdm58_appr_org_id AS appr_org_id , t.tdm58_parent_org_id AS parent_org_id FROM ( SELECT * , emp00_org_code_id AS tdm58_appr_org_id , COALESCE(( SELECT b.emp00_org_code_id FROM tdm58_chck_appr_step a INNER JOIN getPerson(tdm51_company_id, std_date) b ON b.emp00_person_id = a.tdm58_appr_emp_id WHERE a.tdm58_chck_org_id = t.tdm58_chck_org_id AND a.tdm58_appr_seq > t.tdm58_appr_seq ORDER BY a.tdm58_appr_seq LIMIT 1 ),0) AS tdm58_parent_org_id FROM tdm58_chck_appr_step t INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tdm51_chck_org.* , tdm50_start_date std_date FROM tdm51_chck_org INNER JOIN tdm50_chck_job ON ( tdm50_company_id = tdm51_company_id AND tdm50_check_ym = tdm51_check_ym ) WHERE tdm51_chck_org_id = tdm58_chck_org_id ) tdm51 ON TRUE INNER JOIN LATERAL getPerson(tdm51_company_id, std_date) ON emp00_person_id = tdm58_appr_emp_id WHERE tdm58_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} ORDER BY tdm58_appr_seq ) t ORDER BY t.tdm58_appr_seq

SELECT tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt_id AS chck_appr_cmnt_id , tdm59_appr_status_cd AS appr_status_code , emp00_org_code_nm AS appr_org_name , emp00_kor_nm AS appr_emp_name FROM tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM tdm51_chck_org INNER JOIN tdm50_chck_job ON tdm50_chck_job_id = tdm51_chck_job_id INNER JOIN tdm53_chck_exct ON ( tdm53_company_id = tdm51_company_id AND tdm53_check_ym = tdm51_check_ym AND tdm53_role_id = tdm51_role_id ) WHERE tdm51_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} ) t ON tdm53_chck_exct_id = tdm59_chck_exct_id INNER JOIN LATERAL getPerson(tdm51_company_id, tdm50_start_date) ON emp00_person_id = tdm59_appr_emp_id WHERE tdm59_appr_org_id = #{apprOrgId} AND tdm59_cmnt_type = 'SELF'
mapper.update: UPDATE tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt SET tdm59_appr_status_cd = CAST(#{apprStatusCode} AS varchar) WHERE (tdm59_chck_exct_id, tdm59_appr_org_id, tdm59_appr_emp_id) = ( SELECT tdm59_chck_exct_id, tdm59_appr_org_id, tdm59_appr_emp_id FROM tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt WHERE tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt_id = #{chckApprCmntId} ) AND tdm59_cmnt_type = 'SUB' AND tdm59_child_org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm61_chck_insuff_appr ( tdm61_chck_insuff_appr_id, tdm61_chck_insuff_id, tdm61_step_type, tdm61_appr_seq, tdm61_appr_org_id, tdm61_appr_emp_id, tdm61_appr_status_cd, tdm61_appr_cmnt, tdm61_appr_date, tdm61_chck_org_id ) SELECT f_create_seq() , tdm54_chck_insuff_id , '2' , tdm58_appr_seq , emp00_org_code_id , tdm58_appr_emp_id , '10' , null , null , tdm51_chck_org_id FROM tdm51_chck_org INNER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT a.* , ( SELECT MAX(tdm50_check_ym) FROM tdm50_chck_job x WHERE x.tdm50_company_id = a.tdm50_company_id AND x.tdm50_check_ym < a.tdm50_check_ym ) AS pre_check_ym FROM tdm50_chck_job a WHERE tdm50_chck_job_id = tdm51_chck_job_id ) tdm50 ON TRUE INNER JOIN tdm54_chck_insuff ON ( tdm54_company_id = tdm51_company_id AND tdm54_role_id = tdm51_role_id AND tdm54_org_id = tdm51_org_id AND tdm54_status_cd = '19' /*(19:조치완료)*/ ) INNER JOIN tdm58_chck_appr_step ON tdm58_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id INNER JOIN getPerson(tdm50_company_id, tdm50_start_date) ON emp00_person_id = tdm58_appr_emp_id WHERE tdm51_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} ORDER BY tdm54_chck_insuff_id, tdm58_appr_seq
mapper.select: SELECT tdm54_chck_insuff_id AS chck_insuff_id , tdm54_company_id AS company_id FROM tdm51_chck_org INNER JOIN tdm54_chck_insuff ON ( tdm54_company_id = tdm51_company_id AND tdm54_role_id = tdm51_role_id AND tdm54_org_id = tdm51_org_id AND tdm54_status_cd = #{statusCode} ) WHERE tdm51_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId}
